scientific_question: Does the current quality signal arise from composite scan-cell scheduling, scan/VERIFY allocation, or their interaction?

factors.S0: Use the frozen Coverage-Interleave coarse grid in ascending order: unit ids 1,4,7,...,346, four previously unobserved units per SCAN.
factors.S1: Use the current Coverage-Debt midpoint scheduler with priority span/N + 0.5*log2(span+1)/log2(N+1) + 0.25*observed_local_proxy_signal, sequentially updating the temporary observed set within each four-unit batch.
factors.A0: Fixed state-independent phase schedule inherited from Stage-2 Coverage-Interleave: decision epochs 0..28 are SCAN (29 batches cover the 116-unit coarse grid), and every later epoch is VERIFY while a scanned unqueried candidate exists; no observed proxy value changes the allocation schedule.
factors.A1: Current state-dependent allocation inherited from Stage-2 Coverage-Debt: SCAN when no candidate is available or scan_actions <= completed_VERIFY_actions; otherwise VERIFY. If a requested scan order is exhausted, VERIFY if possible, else STOP.

shared_rules.VERIFY_candidate: highest observed physical proxy score among scanned unqueried units
shared_rules.proxy: physical YOLOv8n midpoint frame, original decoded BGR
shared_rules.oracle: fresh cache-free physical Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct service per run
shared_rules.snapshots: commit after every completed SCAN or VERIFY action

execution.smoke: one physical run per cell at T_transition
execution.matrix: 4 cells x 3 deadlines x 3 runtime repeats

decision_rule.Branch_A: C1 clearly improves over C0 and C2 remains close to C0
decision_rule.Branch_B: C2 clearly improves over C0 and C1 remains close to C0
decision_rule.Branch_D: C1, C2, and C3 show no repeatable quality improvement

interpretation_constraint: Three repeats measure runtime stability on one semantic sample; they are not independent semantic samples.
